subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: When a workspace ignore file exceeds the 4 MiB limit, should the affected traversal stop with a diagnostic, or may it continue with an explicit warning?
rationale: The byte bound is mechanically sound, but either policy changes user-visible scan inclusion and the existing shared callers do not establish one canonical behavior.

options.title: Stop affected traversal
options.body: Avoid enumerating content whose exclusion policy could not be loaded and return an actionable nonfatal diagnostic where the caller supports diagnostics.

options.title: Warn and continue
options.body: Continue scanning only after identifying the skipped ignore source and warning that additional paths may be included.

recommendation.title: Stop affected traversal
recommendation.body: Avoid enumerating content whose exclusion policy could not be loaded and return an actionable nonfatal diagnostic where the caller supports diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history signal across the skill and package scan callers that must implement and expose the selected behavior.
